prompts.title: Peaceful Moment with Music in a Hilly Landscape
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic cinematic outdoor portrait of a stylish man sitting casually on a lush green meadow covered with tiny white wildflowers, surrounded by rolling green hills and distant mountains.
He has naturally, slightly tousled hair, and wears dark black rectangular sunglasses and large black over-ear wireless headphones. He is dressed in a black vertically textured button-down shirt with the sleeves casually rolled up to the forearms, relaxed-fit cream trousers , and clean white  sneakers.
Pose: He sits naturally on the grass in a relaxed, thoughtful posture. One knee is raised and bent toward the camera while the other leg extends comfortably forward. Both hands rests casually on his raised knee. His head is tilted slightly upward and to the side, creating a calm, introspective expression.
Background: Beautiful expansive green rolling hills with soft distant mountains, gently blurred for depth. The foreground is filled with lush grass and small white flowers.
Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight coming from the upper left/back side, creating soft highlights along his hair, face, shoulders, and clothing, with natural shadows and subtle rim lighting. Warm sunlight gently illuminates the meadow and hills.
Camera: Eye-level to slightly low perspective, medium-full body composition, subject prominently framed while keeping the scenic landscape visible. 85mm portrait lens, f/1.6, shallow depth of field, creamy background bokeh, realistic perspective.
Style: Ultra-realistic luxury lifestyle photography, cinematic color grading, ultra-detailed skin texture, highly detailed fabric and hair, realistic sunlight, realistic reflections in sunglasses, premium editorial aesthetic, crisp subject details, soft atmospheric depth, 8K photorealism, aspect ratio 4:5 composition.
Face matching: using a reference face, preserve the face with maximum identity accuracy. Do not alter facial structure, proportions or distinctive facial features. No beautification or facial reshaping.
Negative prompt: artificial skin, distorted anatomy, unnatural hands, blurry face, warped sunglasses, deformed headphones, bad proportions, harsh shadows, overexposure, underexposure, low resolution, watermark, text, cropped feet, cropped legs, artificial background.

prompts.title: Pure Audio Bliss
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4K photorealistic studio lifestyle portrait of a joyful young woman listening to music through wireless headphones. Use the reference image for accurate facial likeness and identity matching, preserving facial structure, skin tone, hair color, and overall natural appearance.

Framing & Composition
Waist-up portrait framing. The subject is centered with balanced negative space above the head and on both sides. Composition should feel clean, modern, and suitable for commercial lifestyle photography.

Appearance
Her hair is styled in loose, glossy waves, matching the hair color and texture of the reference image exactly.
Skin appears natural and smooth with realistic texture, avoiding excessive retouching.
Makeup is clean and natural, matching the reference image — natural lip color, soft blush, and neatly groomed eyebrows.
Her eyes are closed and she is smiling naturally, expressing calm happiness and immersion in music.

Outfit
She is wearing a plain white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt as the base layer.
Over it, she wears a soft light pink corduroy pinafore-style overall dress with wide shoulder straps and a structured front panel, visible within the waist-up framing. The corduroy fabric shows fine vertical ribbed texture with realistic folds, creating a casual and youthful lifestyle aesthetic.

Accessories

Large white wireless over-ear headphones with cushioned earcups

Black smartphone with a multi-lens rear camera module

Pose
Right hand gently touching the headphone earcup.
Left hand holding the smartphone.
Body slightly angled to the right.
Head tilted slightly upward and toward the left.

Background
Solid vibrant turquoise-blue seamless studio backdrop, smooth and clean with no visible texture or distractions. No objects in the background.

Lighting
Soft high-key studio lighting using a large diffused softbox from the front-left. Even illumination with minimal shadows and subtle natural facial highlights. No studio equipment visible in frame.

Camera & Technical Details
Eye-level portrait shot.
50mm lens.
f/8 aperture.
Sharp focus across the subject.

Quality & Style
4K resolution, ultra-detailed skin texture, realistic hair strands, accurate corduroy fabric texture, photorealistic lighting, professional color grading, HDR clarity, commercial stock photography style.

Aspect Ratio: 1:1
